verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe confirms that a machine-readable OpenAPI document is downloadable at https://grafana.com/api/openapi.json: it returns HTTP 200 and contains an "openapi" key. That satisfies the core of the story. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the spec and which Grafana API surfaces (OSS/Enterprise HTTP API vs. Grafana Cloud/grafana.com API) it covers, plus independent corroboration of its completeness and usability.
